name: Link
description: Navigates somewhere. Inline links are always underlined; standalone links drop the underline until hover. Without href it renders a button styled as a link, for an action that reads as one.

livewire.name: link
capabilities: navigate adds wire:navigate, so Livewire fetches the page without a full reload

props.name: href
props.description: The destination. Only relative, http, https, mailto, tel and sms URLs are used. Without one, Link renders a button (type="button") with the same styles.
props.a11y: A link navigates; an action without a destination is a button, so screen readers announce what it does.

props.name: tone
props.description: primary for links in running text and calls to action, muted for secondary links such as footers and legal text. Emitted as data-tone.

props.name: standalone
props.description: A link on its own line ("View all properties"): medium weight, underlined only on hover, with room for icons. Emitted as data-standalone.
props.a11y: Only for links that don't sit in running text: inline links keep the underline so color isn't the only cue.

props.name: external
props.description: Opens in a new tab (target="_blank" with rel="noopener noreferrer") and adds the external-link icon and visually hidden text that says so.
props.a11y: Announces that it opens a new tab through externalLabel.

props.name: externalLabel
props.description: The visually hidden text an external link announces. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( '(opens in a new tab)' ).

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon name before the text, resolved through the icon registry. A slot or node overrides it.

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Icon name after the text, such as arrow-right on a standalone link; it replaces the external-link icon. Arrows and chevrons mirror in RTL. A slot or node overrides it.

props.name: navigate
props.description: Adds wire:navigate to an internal link, so Livewire fetches the page and swaps it in without a full reload. Off-site, `#`, `mailto:` and new-tab links load normally.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { icon: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The link, or a button when there's no href.

parts.name: iconEnd
parts.description: The trailing icon, or the external-link icon.

keyboard.action: Follows the link, or activates the button form.

requirements: Uses a native anchor, or a native button when there's no href.
Inline links are underlined, so color isn't the only cue (1.4.1); standalone links are set apart by position and weight.
External links say they open a new tab, in visually hidden text (externalLabel).
The link text says where it goes: never "click here".
Icons are decorative (aria-hidden); an icon-only link needs an aria-label.
